explanation: The theorem takes a p-th root μ of the scalar c in a finite field of characteristic p. It then shows (μ⁻¹•a − 1)^p = 0 for a matrix a in GL n K with a^p = scalar c. The proof combines Frobenius surjectivity (Finite.surjective_of_injective with frobenius_inj), sub_pow_char_of_commute, and some scalar algebra. Mathlib has these ingredients but no single declaration for the matrix statement, and the derivation is more than two short lines. I grepped Mathlib for sub_pow_char_of_commute, frobenius surjectivity and related names and found only those general lemmas.
